title: US government lab is probing Chinese lidar for security vulnerabilities
summary: Keilaf described two major cybersecurity risks that Chinese lidar might present. This has prompted several automakers and autonomous vehicle companies in the U.S. to consider using Chinese lidar sensors as part of their autonomous vehicle sensor suites.
